messages:
Talia (Security): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: partner integrations and the secure onboarding checklist. We promised concrete artifacts for SOC2/ISO reviewers.

Ben (VP Ops): Love this. We should make it actionable: what we ship, what partners must provide, and what to capture in the evidence portal.

Rita (Compliance): At minimum: infra diagram, control owner mapping, access review samples, key rotation records, and a signed shared-controls attestation. For ISO, include crypto algorithms and key destruction logs.

Marco (Infra): For network: we can produce VPC peering configs + Security Group snapshots. For audit data, we support daily JSONL exports to partner buckets or secure SFTP. Proposed path pattern: `partners/<id>/audit/2024-10-<DD>.jsonl`

Talia (Security): Can we include a machine-readable manifest with each export that lists retention and hashing (sha256) so partners can verify integrity?

Marco (Infra): Yes. I'll add a small manifest with fields: date, file_count, sha256_sum, retention_days. Example manifest line: `{\"date\":\"2024-10-12\",\"files\":1,\"sha256\":\"abc123...\",\"retention_days\":90}`

June (Product): BYOK acceptance: require KMS key policy binding to our service account, key usage logs enabled, documented rotation cadence, and a test decrypt workflow. We should decide if HSM-backed BYOK requires an additional security review or is part of premium support.

Rita (Compliance): Add sample support transcripts and incident tickets to the artifacts list 52; SOC2 auditors often ask for those during testing.

Talia (Security): Action items / owners / due dates:
- Marco: log export spec + manifest schema + retention recs 5; due 2024-10-18
- June: BYOK acceptance criteria draft (include HSM decision) 5; due 2024-10-14
- Rita: artifact checklist for SOC2/ISO (include sample tickets/transcripts) 5; due 2024-10-16
- Ben: coordinate pilot partner (suggest BeaconLabs) and timeline 5; due 2024-10-21
Please confirm. :thumbsup:

Ben (VP Ops): Confirmed. I'll reach out to BeaconLabs to pilot the exports + BYOK flow.

lisa-bot: Calendar invite created: "Partner Security Onboarding Office Hours" weekly Wednesdays 09:30-10:00 PT starting 2024-10-09.

Marco (Infra): For the export schema I'll include an example event line (JSONL): `{\"ts\":\"2024-10-12T22:30:12Z\",\"req_id\":\"r_abc123\",\"principal\":\"svc-beacon\",\"action\":\"Invoke\",\"resource\":\"/v1/generate\",\"success\":true,\"region\":\"us-west2\"}`

June (Product): We'll add a brief runnable test harness that partners can run to validate BYOK permissions (one command to encrypt/decrypt a test blob).

Talia (Security): I'll create the shared doc at go/internal/partner-security-playbook and post the link here when ready. We'll review owners next leadership sync. Thanks all!
